target_customer: Angel investor with a portfolio of 20+, actively sourcing deals, frustrated by seeing great startups too late. Also: seed/Series A VCs, micro-fund GPs.
product: Micro-SaaS dashboard that monitors GitHub engineering activity across thousands of startups and surfaces the ones showing unusual acceleration (commit velocity spikes, contributor growth, new repo creation) as a leading indicator for investors.
hook: Spot breakout startups 3 weeks before they hit your inbox. GitHub is the largest free dataset of real-time engineering activity. Nobody packages it for investors. Until now.
story: I was tracking a small fintech startup. Nothing special on the surface. But their GitHub told a different story. In two weeks, their commit velocity tripled. Four new contributors joined. They spun up three new infrastructure repos. Three weeks later, they announced a $4M Series A. The signal was right there in the commit graph the whole time. Public, free, updating in real time. Nobody was reading it.
offer: Free waitlist (early access + monthly signal highlights). Pro EUR 9.97/mo (full dashboard, 50+ startups, filters, enrichment). Insider Circle EUR 97/mo (custom watchlists, API access, Slack alerts, portfolio overlap detection, quarterly trend briefings, private Telegram group).

value_ladder_tiers.name: Free
value_ladder_tiers.includes: Early access to platform, monthly signal highlights email, no login required

value_ladder_tiers.name: Pro
value_ladder_tiers.includes: Full micro-SaaS dashboard, 50+ startups ranked by engineering acceleration, filter by sector/stage/geography, funding data and team size

value_ladder_tiers.name: Insider Circle
value_ladder_tiers.includes: Everything in Pro, custom watchlists, API access, Slack alerts, deeper enrichment, portfolio overlap detection, quarterly trend briefings, private Telegram group

tone_voice: The Data Nerd. Obsessive about signals others ignore. Leads with data or a surprising observation, never with hype. Uses specific numbers instead of vague claims. Admits uncertainty when the signal is ambiguous. Never pitches, always shows. Curious, precise, slightly contrarian.
opportunity_switch: Old way: paying for intent data from vendors who sell the same list to everyone. New way: reading free, public GitHub data that nobody else packages for investors.
false_beliefs: GitHub data is too noisy to be a real signal (Vehicle)
I already have enough deal flow from my network (Internal)
Public data can't give me an edge, everyone has access to it (External)
adjacent_niches: M&A due diligence on engineering teams
